Checked-overflow execution would panic; wrapping arithmetic creates zero bytes before pixel writes. No allocation or execution attempted. Connected remedy/acceptance: checked native dimension/byte-count and pixel-offset relation or fallible unsupported-size rejection before allocation; preserve ordinary two-line/font/cache behavior. Native painting scales and pixel clipping remain qualified by supported size/font input; empty ink bounds and glyph assertion are separate text-admission contracts, not a newly demonstrated arithmetic defect from normal names. lines is always length1or2 before len-1. It seeks a complete planar cuboid structural face, two authored plate orientations, .015 edge margin and .12 hanger reserve. lower>upper excludes reversed mounting interval before contact selection. is_supported finds actual source solid and validates whole backplate; zero/missing/nonstructural source rejects. Board rotation/projection and supports use full authored solid rotation for AABB overlap, enforce pedestrian clearance and validate mounting, but raw public SignSite fields are not privately admitted aggregate guarantees. No general arbitrary outward/quaternion/NaN acceptance claim is inferred. Maximum physical projection follows authored panel size and .12 offset; constant1.5 is policy acceptance in fixture. Fixed axis-aligned structural_face conditions make the simple tangent/outward plate extent test applicable on normal generated sources.
